sr:Swiggy:6000000001500607: About the Role • We are looking for a Captain to join Trip Assist, CREW’s on-trip concierge. You’ll be the person • our travelers are actually talking to while they’re on their trip. When they want to know • tomorrow’s plan, need a dinner spot, or something goes wrong at the hotel, you’re the one who • answers, quickly, warmly and correctly. • You’ll be assigned parts of live trips. You’ll build and maintain the trip plans, keep travelers • informed through the trip, coordinate with hotels, DMCs, guides and vendors, and close every • trip properly once it ends. You’ll report to the Assistant Manager, Trip Assist, and work alongside • Senior Captains who lead trips end to end. • This is a hands-on, execution-heavy role. You’re measured on how fast and accurately you • respond, how smoothly the trip runs, and how the traveler rates the experience at the end. • We’re looking for someone who has been on the ground (or on the phone) while a trip was • actually happening, knows what breaks, and stays calm and quick when it does. • Key Responsibilities • ● Build the trip plan: Put together an accurate day-by-day itinerary using our service • design. Confirm hotel bookings and research sightseeing, dining and activity options, so • every day of the trip is planned and timed.● Add thoughtful touches: Go beyond the template where it makes sense, like a local • food recommendation, a re-timed slot based on a group preference, or a fun activity that • isn’t on the standard list. • ● Respond fast and well: Answer traveler queries within minutes, in simple, warm, • easy-to-read language. No walls of text. • ● Make information visual: Turn plans into checklists, simple maps and neatly formatted • day plans so travelers can take them in at a glance. • ● Flag escalations immediately: When something goes wrong (a room issue, a delayed • flight, a no-show vendor), raise it to the right person right away with full context: what • happened, photos, and the options you’ve already checked. • ● Triage and suggest next steps: Judge how serious an issue is and come to your TL • with a possible solution, not just the problem. • ● Coordinate with partners: Work with hotels, DMCs, guides, transport partners and • on-ground vendors so the trip runs the way it was promised. • ● Follow every process, every time: Run the full trip process without missing a step, • including the end-of-trip NPS message, follow-ups, closing and exporting the chat, and • paying the guide. Don’t just mark a step as done; make sure it’s actually completed. • ● Own the small stuff: Catch timing clashes or gaps in the itinerary and fix them yourself, • without waiting to be told. • ● Use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow, and flag repetitive work that’s worth • automating. • ● Be available for rotational shifts, including nights, weekends and peak season, so • travelers always have someone on the other end. • Required Skills & Qualifications • ● Open to rotational shifts (5-day work week including weekends). • ● 1-5 years of relevant experience in at least one of the following: • ○ A concierge role (hotel, lifestyle or travel concierge) • ○ Handling trips for travelers (trip management, tour coordination, travel desk) • ○ On-ground travel operations (DMC, tour operator, ground handling, events or • group travel) • ● Hands-on vendor coordination: you’ve held a hotel, driver or guide to a service standard • while the traveler was waiting. • ● Fast, clear and warm written communication, especially over chat. • ● Strong ops mindset, bias for action and high ownership. • ● Attention to detail in itineraries: timings, bookings and logistics that add up. • ● Genuine passion for travel and destination knowledge, with the taste to make a trip feel • special. • Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https://medium.com/swiggy-bytes • We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard
